summary: Dr. Robert F. Heizer is referenced solely in his historical capacity as the archaeologist who recorded the Rancho La Brea deposits as archaeological site LAn-159 in 1949. He is cited as a source of record rather than as a commenter or stakeholder expressing any view on the proposed transit project. No position for or against the project is attributed to him.
